## Surfaces that are not captured at all three widths

- `sidebar` is captured at 1440 px only — the surface does not exist at the other widths on this layout (the desktop sidebar is `max-lg:hidden`).
- `mobile-sidebar` is captured at 360, 768 px only — the surface does not exist at the other widths on this layout.

## Surfaces where the two colour modes are the same document

These render inside `components/layouts/anonymous.blade.php` (or the web form's own layout), whose
`<html>` tag carries no `dark` class and never reads the `dark_mode` cookie. Their `dark:`
utilities exist but no ancestor ever gets the class, so the light and dark baselines are
pixel-identical. Captured in both modes anyway, because the moment one of these pages gains dark
support the comparison has to show it:

- `login` — /admin/login
- `forget-password` — /admin/forget-password
- `reset-password` — /admin/reset-password/{token}
- `public-web-form` — the public web form (rendered at /web-forms/forms/{form_id}/form.html)

## Surfaces where the cookie changes the pixels without setting the class

Both baselines exist and they are different images, but for a reason other than the theme:

- `error-404` — the `dark_mode` cookie swaps the logo to `dark-logo.svg` but never sets the `dark` class, so its light and dark baselines differ only by the mark

## Surfaces declared but not captured

- `modal` (6 cells) — the mega-search results list re-renders on a debounced keystroke and its rows shift between loads (measured: 1,800-4,200 differing pixels over unchanged code), so the cells are declared but not captured
